Led by [[Lord Darius Ravenwood]], they fought the Greymane loyalists during the [[Gilnean civil war]], which occurred as a result of King [[Genn Greymane]]'s decisions to leave the [[Alliance of Lordaeron]], to isolate his kingdom from the world behind the Greymane Wall, and further instigated to divide and weaken the people of the human nation as part of a plot schemed by [[Regent-Lady Celia Harlow|Celia]] and [[Regent-Lord Mortimer Harlow|Mortimer Harlow]]. ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Human organizations]] [[Category:Gilneas (kingdom)]]
